chars.W: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing an emerald green satin kaftan with gold embroidery and a cream headscarf, gold bracelets.
chars.H: HUSBAND: a young Moroccan barber (27) wearing a crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves, black trousers, a neat black beard drawn on the white head, a silver watch.
chars.P: PARENTS: an older Moroccan man in a beige djellaba with a red fez and an older woman in a lilac djellaba and white headscarf.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a small family party in a modern Moroccan apartment living room with balloons and a cake on a table, the WIFE sits on a sofa with arms crossed, sulking and frowning hard, looking away; seen from across the room as if by her husband, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Party in the new apartment: in the foreground the HUSBAND holds a glass of mint tea and smiles at guests, while behind him the WIFE glares at him with an annoyed face, arms crossed. Medium shot, both faces visible.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND stands in the party living room scratching his head, puzzled and worried, glancing sideways at someone off-screen, a thought expression. Head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The HUSBAND warmly kisses the forehead of his old father in the party living room while his mother smiles proudly, a tray of sweets on the table, emotional thankful moment.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Late at night after the party, empty living room with leftover balloons and cups: the HUSBAND hugs his WIFE tenderly and smiles; the WIFE stays stiff in his arms with a cold, unimpressed face.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, the WIFE has pushed away from the HUSBAND and points firmly at her own chest with an angry proud face, as if saying it was all thanks to her; the HUSBAND stands surprised with open hands.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan kitchen at night, the WIFE counts on her fingers angrily, listing everything she did, leaning forward with an irritated face. Head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the apartment hallway, the WIFE stands with hands on hips making a demand, chin up, eyes narrowed; the HUSBAND, seen from behind her shoulder, looks at her shocked with wide eyes.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of the HUSBAND frozen in shock, mouth open, holding the key ring of the new apartment in his hand, while the WIFE in the background waits with crossed arms for his answer. Tense suspense mood, dim warm light.
